_comment: #117 — English is the source of truth. Every other locale file carries exactly this key set; the locale-parity test fails a build where they diverge, including one where a placeholder was dropped or invented. Keys are dotted and area-first (landing.*, settings.*) so a translator can work through one surface at a time. Placeholders are {name}, never {{name}} — the double-brace form is Bowire's own variable syntax and appears literally inside some strings.
